config.reincarnation.title: Reincarnation Settings
config.reincarnation.server.lifecycle.au: When a dead player respawns, advance their generation and start a new life using the current reset settings.
config.reincarnation.server.lifecycle.fi: Filter reincarnation by lethal damage type
Only automatically reincarnate when the final lethal damage type is in reincarnation:reincarnate_on_death. Requires automatic death reincarnation; other deaths use normal respawning.
config.reincarnation.server.reset.scores: Clear the player's scoreboard scores when reincarnating.
config.reincarnation.server.reset.team.t: Remove the player from their scoreboard team when reincarnating.
config.reincarnation.server.reset.unknow: Clear unknown persistent mod data and skip attachment retention from the keep_on_rebirth tag. Registered reincarnation handlers can still explicitly restore their own data.
config.reincarnation.server.reset.keep_g: Keep the previous life's game mode. When disabled, use the server's default game mode.
config.reincarnation.server.query.histor: Number of generations shown on each history page (1–50).
message.reincarnation.lifespan.deceased: Your lifespan ran out; you may only watch this world now.
config.reincarnation.server.lifespan.ena: Enables seeding, settlement and warnings. API, command and action writes remain available while disabled.
config.reincarnation.server.lifespan.bas: Initial and new-life lifespan in ticks. The default 1440000 ticks is 60 years at the default display scale. Zero disables automatic seeding.
config.reincarnation.server.lifespan.set: Game ticks between settlements. Offline time is never charged.
config.reincarnation.server.lifespan.age: Lifespan ticks spent per settlement; zero disables natural ageing.
config.reincarnation.server.lifespan.on_: Choose nothing, death or rebirth. Separate settings control player death and player rebirth.
config.reincarnation.server.lifespan.pla: Kill deals lifespan damage and uses normal death. Spectator changes the game mode without a death event.
New life archives the previous life and replaces the player. Reset reopens the ledger and fires addon reset events in place. Non-player beings always reset in place.
config.reincarnation.server.lifespan.war: Warns once in chat when remaining life is at or below this fraction of total life, including on login or after a config change. Recover above the threshold to allow another warning. Zero disables warnings.
config.reincarnation.server.lifespan.tic: Display conversion only; one displays ticks directly. Does not change the ageing rate.
